title: Site
description: Represents a cleaning site or location where services are performed.

name.description: The name of the site (e.g., 'Villa Ahmed', 'Office Building A').

clientId.description: Reference to the Client who owns this site.

address.description: The physical address of the site.

specialInstructions.description: Special instructions or notes for cleaning this site.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the site was created (Firestore Timestamp).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the site was last updated (Firestore Timestamp).
